skills.name: Consume
skills.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy, restoring health equal to the damage dealt. If the target is Marked or affected by a Curse skill, this skill heals an additional 10 HP.
skills.needs: Mark or a Curse on the target

skills.name: Channel
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. If any target damaged by this skill is Marked, an additional turn is added to the duration. Channeled.

skills.name: Ravage
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Against Stunned targets, deals 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Chain Detonation
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 damage to their allies. If any of the targets are Ignited, they Explode.

skills.name: Blazing Fury
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Flameborn.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If the target is Ignited, they Explode.

skills.name: Flamethrower
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. Each Ignited enemy damaged by this skill causes an Explosion. Channeled.

skills.name: Pyrokinesis
skills.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy. If the target is Ignited or Scorched, this skill deals double damage.
skills.needs: Ignite or Scorch on the target

skills.name: Searing Brand
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the target was Ignited, they gain 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

skills.name: Searing Aegis
skills.description: Grants 10 Shield and Flameborn to all allies for 3 turns.
skills.needs: Ignites or Explosions to fuel Flameborn

skills.name: Blastwave
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and an additional random enemy. If either target is Ignited, they Explode.

skills.name: Frost Spines
skills.description: For 1 turn, the user will counter any Harmful skill used on them. If a skill is countered this way, the user gains Frostborn for 3 turns. Invisible.

skills.name: Comet Shard
skills.description: The user deals 50 Piercing damage to target enemy on the following turn. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled. If the target is Chilled, this skill strikes instantly.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.description: At the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to target enemy and afflicts them with Frostbitten for 1 turn. If the user is Frostborn, this affects all enemies. Channeled.

skills.name: Glacial Sweep
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If that enemy is affected by a Frost debuff, this skill also hits an additional random enemy.
skills.needs: a Frost debuff on the target

skills.name: Permafrost
skills.description: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. If the user is Frostborn, this Shield increases to 35.

skills.name: Drown
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Against Stunned targets, extends their active Stuns by 1 turn.

skills.name: Water Lash
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies. If the user has Flow, damaged targets receive 1 Weakness.

skills.name: Whale Call
skills.description: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable. Stunned or Taunted enemies also take 15 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Tidal Pull
skills.description: Taunts target enemy for 3 turns. The cooldown of this skill resets if the user gains Flow while it is on cooldown.

skills.name: Jolt
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each Charge the user has.

skills.name: Static Slam
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If the user is Charged, the target's allies take 15 damage and are Sapped.

skills.name: Feedback Loop
skills.description: For 1 turn, the user will counter the next Harmful skill used against them. When this triggers, it consumes the user's Charge, lowering this skill's cooldown by 1 per Charge.

skills.name: Particle Beam
skills.description: The user deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy on the following turn. This also hits any Sapped enemies. Channeled.

skills.name: Static Burst
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies. Consumes the user's Charge to deal 10 additional damage per Charge.

skills.name: Static Elemental
skills.description: Summons a Static Elemental minion (15 HP) for 3 turns. If the user has Charge, one is consumed to give the Elemental 1 Might. Zap (r): 10 damage to target enemy, +5 if they are Sapped.
skills.needs: Charge on the user, Sapped enemies

skills.name: Malectrocute
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 if the user is Charged and +10 if the target is Sapped.
skills.needs: Charge on the user, Sapped target

skills.name: System Shock
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn, or 2 turns if they are Sapped.

skills.name: Defibrillate
skills.description: Heals target ally for 20 Health, +5 per Charge the user has.

skills.name: Lightning Cage
skills.description: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, plus 10 per current Charge. The user gains Charge whenever this Shield takes damage.

skills.name: Leaping Strike
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If used while Leaping, also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Vortex
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. If the user is Leaping or Rushing when a tick fires, an additional turn is added (once). Channeled.

skills.name: Sonic Thrust
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user isn't Rushing, they are Stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Falling Slam
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies. Costs 1 GEN less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

skills.name: Slipstream
skills.description: The user gains 15 Shield, increased by 15 if the user is Rushing.

skills.name: Acid Orb
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If the target is Prey, they are Marked and gain 1 Vulnerable.

skills.name: Envenom
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerability. If used against Prey or Invulnerable targets, applies 2 Toxin.

skills.name: Lacerate
skills.description: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn. If they are Prey, they are Stunned for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Tail Lash
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies. If this strikes any Prey, its cooldown is reset.

skills.name: Worldfist
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, +5 for each allied minion.

skills.name: Worldquake
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to its allies. Costs 1 GEN less per allied minion.

skills.name: Launch Stone
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Can instead target an allied Boulder, launching it at a random enemy for damage equal to its remaining HP; this destroys the Boulder.

skills.name: Tunnelmaker
skills.description: In 2 turns, the user deals 65 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Boulder, one is consumed to make it land a turn sooner. Channeled.

skills.name: Verdant Burst
skills.description: Channel Growth, then deal 25 damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Stone Drill
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +20 if the user has at least 3 total Armor and Might.
skills.needs: 3+ Armor and Might on the user

skills.name: Grovetender
skills.description: Channel Growth, then heal target ally for 15 HP.

skills.name: Earth Pillar
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, if a Boulder damages them, they are Stunned for 1 turn.
skills.needs: a Boulder launched at the target

skills.name: Verse of Nurturing
skills.description: Channel Growth twice, then heal all allies for 25 HP and give them 2 Renew.

skills.name: Righteous Blow
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If the user is Anointed, deals an additional 10 damage and heals the user for 10.

skills.name: Sunbeam
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Consumes Anointed on the user to heal them for 15.

skills.name: Cloister
skills.description: The user gains Immune for 1 turn. If they are Anointed, this skill also grants Invulnerable.

skills.name: Holy Nova
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. If the user is Anointed, this skill strikes again at the start of the user's next turn.

skills.name: Piercing Light
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy. If the target is Condemned or Sanctified, this skill deals an additional 10 damage. If the user is Anointed, the bonus always applies.
skills.needs: Condemned/Sanctify on target or Anointed user

skills.name: Karmic Marking
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the user is Anointed, the target is Sanctified for 2 turns.

skills.name: Saving Grace
skills.description: Heals allies for 10 health and grants them 10 Shield. If the user is Anointed, this repeats at the start of the user's next two turns.

skills.name: Guardian Strike
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and an additional random enemy. If a Sanctified target is struck by this skill, all allies are healed for 5 health.

skills.name: Shield of Faith
skills.description: The user gains 20 Shield. If they are Anointed, they also gain Immune for 2 turns.

skills.name: Witchblade
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If the enemy is Horrified, this skill deals 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Bone Shard
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each Soul Fragment the user has.

skills.name: Soul Blast
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies, increased by 10 for each Soul Fragment the user has.

skills.name: Drain Soul
skills.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy, draining a Soul Fragment from them. If the target is Horrified, the user gains an additional Soul Fragment.

skills.name: Cripple
skills.description: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable. If they are Horrified, they also gain 1 permanent Weakness.

skills.name: Grisly Spectacle
skills.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy and extends all active Horrify effects by 1 turn. The user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

skills.name: Soulshriek
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Soul Fragment, consumes one to deal 10 additional damage and Horrify the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Unrelenting Horror
skills.description: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns. If the target is Horrified, the user also gains Lifesteal for that time.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if the user is Stealthed.

skills.name: Shadowbrand
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Sanctifies them for 2 turns. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

skills.name: Wyrmclaw
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, plus 5 for every 2 Hoard the user has. Hoard isn't spent.

skills.name: Skyfall Breath
skills.description: The user circles overhead, Untargetable by enemies until it lands. On the following turn, deals 35 damage to target enemy, plus Breath. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.

skills.name: Burning Wake
skills.description: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. While it lasts, each Ignite they applied also deals its damage at the start of its bearer's turn.

skills.name: Drake
skills.description: Summons a Drake (40 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, if any enemy is Ignited, it gives the user 1 Hoard. Drake Claw (r): 15 damage and Scorched for 1 turn.

skills.name: Wyrmbolt
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Ignited, their Ignite deals its damage twice right now.

skills.name: Great Breath
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies, plus Breath. Ignited enemies take 10 more.

skills.name: Molten Maw
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, 15 more if they're Scorched. For 2 turns, each time their Ignite deals damage, they're Scorched for 1 turn.
skills.needs: Ignite or Scorched on the target

skills.name: Warming Wings
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each time an Ignite they applied deals damage, the ally with the least HP heals as much.

skills.name: Hearthfire
skills.description: Target ally heals 15, plus 10 for each Hoard the user spends, up to 3.

skills.name: Pyre Brand
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, and they're Scorched for 1 turn. When that Scorch ends, they Explode if they're still Ignited.

skills.name: Worldbreaker
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, then the target gains Frostfire. If that Thermal Shocks them, each of their allies with a Fire or Frost debuff is Shocked too.
skills.needs: Fire or Frost debuffs on enemies

skills.name: Comet of Ruin
skills.description: On the following turn, deals 45 damage to target enemy. If they gain a Fire or Frost debuff first, it lands at once and Thermal Shocks them. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.
skills.needs: another skill's Fire or Frost debuff

skills.name: Steamstep
skills.description: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and for 1 more turn after that, Invulnerable to enemies with a Fire debuff.

skills.name: Twofold Ruin
skills.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy, +10 for each Fire or Frost debuff they have. Then those debuffs are removed.
skills.needs: Fire or Frost debuffs on the target

skills.name: Tempered
skills.description: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their direct damage deals 10 more to Shattered enemies.

skills.name: Heat Death
skills.description: Target enemy gains Frostfire, then 1 Confusion for 2 turns per Fire or Frost debuff they have, Frostfire included (max 3).
skills.needs: other Fire or Frost debuffs on the target

skills.name: Fimbul Vigil
skills.description: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, Chilled enemies' skills also cost 1 more random energy.

skills.name: Split Horizon
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who also gains copies of the target's Fire and Frost debuffs.
skills.needs: Fire or Frost debuffs on the target

skills.name: Heart of the Glacier
skills.description: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns, and is Frostborn while any of it remains.

skills.name: Circle of Extremes
skills.description: Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns, and every Fire and Frost debuff on their allies moves onto them.
skills.needs: Fire or Frost debuffs on enemies

skills.name: Calcining Blow
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Their Ignite ticks at once, plus once more for each Buff they have (max 3 more).

skills.name: Kiln Crash
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. For 2 turns, Scorched on any of them also halves their Shield, at the end of each of the user's turns.

skills.name: Steam Rush
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. The user gains 1 Renew for each Ignited enemy (max 3).

skills.name: Chain Reaction
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies. Each enemy with Catalyst Explodes.

skills.name: Boiling Point
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user boils off all their Renew, and the target's Ignite ticks once per stack (max 4).
skills.needs: Renew on the user and Ignite on target

skills.name: Splash Potion
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the target has Catalyst, it splashes: both hits are doubled.

skills.name: Coronal Slam
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Until they end, the Ignites on every enemy it hits deal double.

skills.name: Discharge Ward
skills.description: For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user. Vent: its user takes 10 Affliction damage per Heat removed and is Ignited. Invisible.

skills.name: Heat Sink
skills.description: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Vent: they gain 10 Shield per Heat removed, for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hot Wire
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. Vent: that threshold rises by 10 HP per Heat removed.

skills.name: Plasma Cutter
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each Charge the user spends on it (all of it). Each Charge spent becomes 1 Heat.

skills.name: Short Circuit
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. Vent: for every 2 Heat removed, a random other enemy is stunned the same way.

skills.name: Cauterizing Shock
skills.description: Target ally heals 20. Vent: they gain 1 Charge per 2 Heat removed.

skills.name: Quench Brand
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctifies them for 1 turn. Vent: the Sanctify heals 5 more per Heat removed.

skills.name: Heat Exchange
skills.description: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield for 1 turn. If the user Melts Down before their next turn, the Meltdown heals every ally 20 and doesn't hurt the user.
skills.needs: a Melt Down (5 Heat or Overload Burst)

skills.name: Flare Beacon
skills.description: Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 1 turn. Vent: 1 more turn if any Heat was removed, and 1 Sapped per 2 Heat removed.

skills.name: Piston Punch
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, and a random allied minion is Upgraded.

skills.name: Steam Hammer
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user is Rushing, it vents: their Rushing ends, and the splash is 30 and Ignites.

skills.name: Boiler Fury
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and 1 more Might each time their side causes an Explosion (max 3 more).

skills.name: Rivet Gun
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the last one to damage them was an allied minion, that minion is Upgraded.
skills.needs: an allied minion hitting the target

skills.name: Pressure Cascade
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies, +10 for each ally of the user who used a skill earlier this turn.
skills.needs: allies using skills earlier this turn

skills.name: Refuel
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. The user burns all their Swiftness as fuel: 10 more healing per stack.

skills.name: Autogyro
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Ghosted and begins Rushing. At the end of each of their turns they're still Rushing, every allied minion is Upgraded.

skills.name: Tune-Up
skills.description: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their damaging skills don't end their Leap; it ends only when they take damage.

skills.name: Signal Flare
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each allied minion that damages them is Upgraded.

skills.name: Steam Whistle
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Every allied minion is Upgraded, and loses that level again after 2 turns.

skills.name: Brimquake
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. For 2 turns, Explosions deal 10 more to each enemy it hit.

skills.name: Choking Lunge
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. Until the user's next turn, Toxin on the target also ticks at the start of the target's turn.

skills.name: Brimstone Hide
skills.description: For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user. Its user gains 2 Sulfur; if they're Ignited, it Erupts at once and the user heals as much as it deals them. Invisible.

skills.name: Scent of Cinders
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and every Ignited or Scorched enemy counts as Prey.

skills.name: Burning Downpour
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies. Then each one's Ignite ticks once for every 2 Toxin they have (max 3).

skills.name: Caustic Flame
skills.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to target enemy, +10 per Toxin on them. Then their Toxin is burned away.

skills.name: Brimfire Crest
skills.description: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and Flameborn, and their Flameborn heals them for all the Affliction damage they deal, not just their Ignites'.

skills.name: Sulfurous Miasma
skills.description: Target enemy's Toxin turns into Sulfur, stack for stack (max 4), and they're Confused for 2 turns.

skills.name: Hellsong
skills.description: All allies heal 15 and gain Flameborn for 2 turns, which also heals them 10 for each Eruption their side causes.

skills.name: Burning Tail
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Sulfur as the target has.

skills.name: Sunspot
skills.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user takes 15 Affliction damage per Corona the user has, and the user's Corona lasts 2 turns longer. Invisible.

skills.name: Zenith Spear
skills.description: On the following turn, deals 45 damage to target enemy. Flare: when it lands, every ally heals 10 per Corona spent. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.

skills.name: Noonburst
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies. Flare: 10 more to each per Corona, but the user is Scorched for 1 turn per Corona spent.

skills.name: Lingering Light
skills.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it, 10 more if the target is Ignited. The user gains 1 Corona, and all their Corona lasts 2 turns longer.

skills.name: Long Summer
skills.description: For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Corona. While it channels, their Corona doesn't expire and deals double to Ignited enemies. Channeled.

skills.name: Blinding Noon
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Blinded for 1 turn per Corona the user has (at least 1). Invisible.

skills.name: Sunstroke
skills.description: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn and Ignited. Flare: 1 more turn of Stun per 2 Corona.

skills.name: Pillar of Noon
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Flare: for 1 turn per Corona spent, allies who damage them gain 1 Corona.

skills.name: Hymn to the Sun
skills.description: All allies heal 20. Flare: every ally gains 1 Corona per 2 Corona spent, rounded up.

skills.name: Dawn Chorus
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Every allied minion gains 1 Corona, and it ticks once now.

skills.name: Wingbeat
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. The beat fans the user's side: each ally in Ashes rises at the end of this turn instead of their next.

skills.name: Searing Rebuttal
skills.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. If its user is Ignited, the Ignite burns once at once, and the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn. Invisible.

skills.name: Sunfall Lance
skills.description: On the following turn, deals 50 damage to target enemy. It still fires if the user is in Ashes when it lands, and then deals 25 more. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.

skills.name: Pyre Talon
skills.description: Kindle: 25 Piercing damage and Ignite to target enemy, 15 more if they're Stunned. On an ally, it's 25 healing and 2 Renew, and it ends their Stun.

skills.name: Flaring Feint
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and their Ignite flares: it burns three times at once. Invisible.

skills.name: Blinding Plumage
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Stuns them for 1 turn. If they're Condemned, the Stun lasts 3 turns, as their Condemnation can't trigger meanwhile.

skills.name: Dance of Embers
skills.description: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus. Meanwhile, each Kindle skill they use on an enemy also heals the user's ally with the least HP for half its damage.

skills.name: Sanctified Pyre
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctifies them for 2 turns. Each time the Sanctify heals someone, their Ignite burns once.

skills.name: Fanned Flames
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each one's Ignite burns once at once, and the user heals as much as those burns deal.

skills.name: Phoenix Cry
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Each ally of the user who is in Ashes or has risen this battle gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 2 turns.

skills.name: Faustian Fury
skills.description: The user signs a Contract (3 turns): 2 Might, Flameborn and Immortal now; price: 30 Affliction damage and Horrified for 2 turns.

skills.name: Infernal Coin
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. An Ignite on them becomes Hellfire for 2 turns; if they already had Hellfire, the user gains 1 Soul Fragment.
skills.needs: Ignite or Hellfire on the target

skills.name: Collection Day
skills.description: On the following turn, deals 40 damage to target enemy; if they have a Contract, its price is collected now, doubled. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.

skills.name: Hellstorm
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies. The user spends all their Soul Fragments (up to 3), and every enemy gains Hellfire for 1 turn per fragment spent.

skills.name: Imp Captain
skills.description: Summons an Imp Captain (25 HP) for 3 turns. Ember Whip (r): 10 damage to target enemy. Its hits deal 5 more per Soul Fragment the user has, without spending them.

skills.name: Toasting Fork
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, the user heals 5 at the end of each of their turns while the target is Ignited, whoever lit it.

skills.name: Soul Snare
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user gains a Soul Fragment for each Ignite and Scorch they carry. Invisible.
skills.needs: Ignites or Scorched on the target

skills.name: Binding Clause
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, who is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 turns if they hold a Contract.

skills.name: Dance with the Devil
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and Ignites they apply also burn at the start of each of their turns.

skills.name: Infernal Shriek
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; those with Hellfire are Intimidated twice, and the user gains 1 Soul Fragment for each.

skills.name: Warding Candle
skills.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and their Rite can't be broken until the end of their next turn. Invisible.

skills.name: Chains of Smoke
skills.description: For 2 turns, each Harmful skill target enemy uses deals them 10 Affliction damage and advances the user's Rite by 1. Invisible.

skills.name: Shadow Acolyte
skills.description: Summons a Shadow Acolyte (30 HP) permanently; each skill it uses advances its summoner's Rite. Chant (r): target ally heals 10. Flame Lash (r): 10 damage and Ignite.

skills.name: Dark Liturgy
skills.description: For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to all enemies and advances the user's Rite by 1. While it lasts, the user can't be Stunned or put to Sleep. Channeled.

skills.name: Ritual Knife
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if it's the skill that completes the user's Rite.

skills.name: Circle of Warding
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user's Rite completes at once. Invisible.

skills.name: Dance of Candles
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each skill they use advances their Rite by 1 more.

skills.name: Invocation
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. The user's Rite advances by 1 per enemy that's Blinded or Ignited.
skills.needs: an active Rite; Blinded or Ignited enemies

skills.name: Effigy
skills.description: Creates an Effigy (10 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If the Effigy is destroyed, the user's Rite completes at once.

skills.name: Avatar of the Rite
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and any Rite of theirs that completes meanwhile takes effect twice.

skills.name: Faceted Hammer
skills.description: Deals 20 damage and 1 Brittle to target enemy. Each of their other Frost debuffs crystallizes: it ends, and they gain 1 more Brittle for it.

skills.description: For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user, and the user gains 1 Charge. If that fills their Charge, it's spent to Anoint them for 2 turns instead. Invisible.

skills.name: Rebuking Bolt
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who is Marked for 1 turn. If Wrath adds to it, their non-Strategic skills are also stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Siphon Grace
skills.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy, and the user heals 10. Their Wrath is spent on healing instead of damage: 15 more per stack.

skills.name: Grounded Point
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If the user's Charge is full, it's restored to full again once it's spent next turn.

skills.name: Spark of Mercy
skills.description: Target ally heals 20. Each time their Charge turns into energy in the next 2 turns, they heal 10.

skills.name: Gathering Oath
skills.description: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield for 1 turn. Then every ally's Charge moves to the user.

skills.name: Arc of Justice
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and to every Condemned enemy, or to a random other enemy if none is; each Condemned enemy hit has their Condemnation trigger now.

skills.name: Deadhand
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. A Reanimated user deals 10 more and skips their next 5 HP loss.

skills.name: Dead Man's Switch
skills.description: For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user; if the user is Galvanized, it's spent to Reflect the skill instead. Invisible.

skills.name: Necrobolt
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who is Marked for 1 turn. A Reanimated user deals 10 more for each turn they've been back, up to 30.

skills.name: Soul Surge
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies, +10 for each Galvanized or Reanimated unit on the user's team.

skills.name: Life Siphon
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, and the user heals 10, +10 if the target is Horrified. A Reanimated user gains the healing as Shield instead.

skills.name: Electrocution
skills.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user is Reanimated, it executes a target it leaves at or below 25 HP.

skills.name: Nerve Shock
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Stuns them for 1 turn. While they're Stunned, each Sapped they gain counts twice.

skills.name: Soul Spark
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them gain 10 Shield, or 20 if they're Reanimated.

skills.name: Surge from the Dark
skills.description: Each ally passes the user their Charge; then 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +5 to each hit per Charge passed.

skills.name: EMP
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies, and each is Suppressed for 1 turn, +1 per Charge the user spends on it (all of it).

skills.name: Dark Hum
skills.description: For up to 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies, plus 10 for each time the user's Charge has turned into energy since it began. Channeled, Stealthy.

skills.name: Circuit Breaker
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If they're Suppressed, one of their Buffs also ends.

skills.name: Arc Ambush
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; it doesn't wake a Sleeping target, and Saps them twice instead.

skills.name: Rising Air
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, and the user gains Aloft for 2 turns. If they were already Aloft, they dive instead: the target's non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hailfall
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to every other unit on the field that isn't Leaping or Aloft, the user's allies included.

skills.name: Downdraft
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user is Aloft, they end it to deal 20 more.

skills.name: Gust Front
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, and the user gains Aloft for 1 turn. If they were already Aloft, the second hit goes to the enemy with the least HP instead.

skills.name: Gale Warning
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Each ally with Swiftness trades 1 of it to begin Rushing.

skills.name: Cloudbank
skills.description: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. If it breaks while they're Rushing, they Leap.

skills.name: Wild Hunt
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might. Whenever they hit an enemy while Leaping, that enemy is marked as Prey for 2 turns.

skills.name: Pixie Dust
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, who gains 1 Confusion. If they already had Confusion, they're Charmed for 1 turn instead.

skills.name: Petal Step
skills.description: The user Leaps; their Leap's bonus damage is 5 per Toxin on the target it hits instead of 5.

skills.name: Wisp Bolt
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who is Marked for 1 turn. For 2 turns, whenever the user starts a turn Rushing, a random ally gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus too.

skills.name: Wasp Dive
skills.description: The user spends all their Swiftness, then deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 per stack spent.

skills.name: Fickle Heart
skills.description: Target enemy is Taunted by a random ally of theirs for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey, so that ally is all they can target.

skills.name: Break Camp
skills.description: The user begins Rushing. If they have an allied Boulder or Seedling, they pack one up: it's removed, and they gain 2 Trek.

skills.name: Spotter's Bolt
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who is Marked for 1 turn. An allied minion's hit on them meanwhile deals 10 more.

skills.name: Scour
skills.description: The user gives up all their mobility buffs; then 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each one given up.

skills.name: Cairn Blessing
skills.description: Target ally gains 1 Might for 3 turns. Each time they use a mobility skill meanwhile, the user creates a Boulder.

skills.name: Dust in the Wind
skills.description: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. If the user has an allied Boulder, they crumble it into the wind and vault off it: the target gains 1 more Confusion, and the user Leaps.

skills.name: Quill of Light
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, a Sanctify on them heals the damager's whole team, not just the damager.

skills.name: Endless Verdict
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, their Condemnations don't end when they trigger.

skills.name: Piercing Feather
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. An Anointed user trades it for a dive: they spend Anointed to Leap before the hit, so its bonus applies and they stay Invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Seraphic Form
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and their single-target Helpful skills affect every ally at once. Meanwhile, they can't use Harmful skills.

skills.name: Phantom Blade
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, who is Haunted for 1 turn. A Haunt already on them ticks now and doesn't drift this turn.

skills.name: Poltergeist Crash
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, and the target is Haunted for 2 turns. If they already were, the Haunt splits: a second one lands on a random ally of theirs.

skills.name: Rend the Living
skills.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, a Horrify on them also stops them from being healed.

skills.name: Soul Transfer
skills.description: Target ally heals 15, +10 per Soul Fragment the user spends, up to 2; with 2 spent, the ally also Leaps.

skills.name: Dirge of Spirits
skills.description: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, each ally's Swiftness also shrugs off a Taunt, spending 1 stack.

skills.name: Keening
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. For as long, the user's side's Rushing doesn't end after a turn in which they used no skill.

skills.name: Whirlwind of Blades
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others. If the user has 3 Clones, they're thrown: each is destroyed and deals 10 to a random enemy; otherwise the user creates a Clone.

skills.name: Second Draw
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If the user is still Rushing at the start of their next turn, it strikes the same enemy again for 10.

skills.name: Quickdraw
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user was Leaping, they land in the shadows and gain Stealth.

skills.name: Barbed Quill
skills.description: I: 25 Affliction damage to target enemy on the following turn. II: against Prey, it lands at once. III: it also hits every other Prey enemy. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled, Uncounterable.

skills.name: Opportunist
skills.description: I: 5 Piercing damage; against Prey, the user gains 1 random energy. II: 15 Piercing against targets at or below 40 HP. III: it executes Prey below 15 HP.

skills.name: Envenomed Rend
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable. I: Prey targets gain 2 Toxin. II: a Stunned target's Toxin doubles instead. III: every target's Toxin doubles instead.
skills.needs: Toxin or Prey on the target

skills.name: Paralytic Bite
skills.description: I: target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if Prey. II: they count as Prey while Stunned. III: when it ends, a random Prey ally of theirs is Stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Delirium
skills.description: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Debuff stack on them counts as 2 toward Prey.
skills.needs: another Debuff stack on the target

skills.name: Thrashing Tail
skills.description: I: 15 damage to all enemies; if it hits Prey, its cooldown resets. II: if it hits none, an enemy with Toxin becomes Prey for 1 turn. III: Prey take 10 more.
skills.needs: Prey enemies (or Toxin to make one)

skills.name: Festering Howl
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. While it lasts, their Toxin can't be removed, moved or reduced.

skills.name: Exoskeleton
skills.description: The user gains 15 Shield and 1 Armor for 2 turns, during which each Weakness on an enemy lowers their damage to the user by 10 instead of 5.

skills.name: Moldering Fist
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, who gains 1 Spore. If a Mushroom sprouts from them, the user also gains 1 Might and 1 Armor for good.

skills.name: Puffball Stomp
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If they have Spores, they lose them, and each of their allies gains that many.

skills.name: Root Rot
skills.description: In 2 turns, deals 50 damage to target enemy and 15 to each of their allies with Spores. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.

skills.name: Sporeling
skills.description: Summons a Sporeling (40 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently. Infecting Lash (r): 10 damage and 1 Spore. It gains 10 max HP and heals 10 whenever a Mushroom sprouts for its side.
skills.needs: Mushrooms sprouting from other Spore sources

skills.name: Sporestorm
skills.description: Every allied Seedling, Mushrooms included, Puffs, giving a random enemy 1 Spore; then deals 25 damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Soft Ground
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered: they're Stunned for 1 turn if they carry Spores, or gain 2 Spores if they don't. Invisible.

skills.name: Fungal Shroud
skills.description: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn and gains 1 Spore. If they have 2 or more Spores when it ends, a Mushroom sprouts from them.

skills.name: Spore Whirl
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to another enemy with Spores (random if several), who gains 1 more.

skills.name: Humus Wall
skills.description: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Each enemy hit it absorbs triggers Channel Growth for the user's Seedlings.

skills.name: Fungal Colossus
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and absorbs each Mushroom that sprouts for them: instead of the minion, they gain 1 Armor and heal 15.

skills.name: Shared Absolution
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Until the user's next turn, Sanctify on any of them heals every ally of the damager, not only the damager.

skills.name: Apothecary
skills.description: Summons an Apothecary (15 HP) for 3 turns. Milk Venom (r): 10 damage to target enemy; if they have Toxin, a random ally is Inoculated.

skills.name: Theriac Brand
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctifies them for 1 turn. Their poison sweetens it: the Sanctify heals 5 more per Toxin on them.

skills.name: Twin Fangs
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. If one of them is Condemned, the other is marked as Prey for 2 turns.

skills.name: Rotspear
skills.description: On the following turn, target enemy takes 25 Affliction damage, +10 per Withered they have. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled. Uncounterable.

skills.name: Seep Away
skills.description: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn, the Toxin they applied ticks once more.

skills.name: Long Decay
skills.description: For 2 turns, +1 turn per Withered enemy, at the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 Affliction damage to all enemies. Channeled.

skills.name: Feast on Fear
skills.description: Target ally heals 15, +10 for each Horrified enemy.

skills.name: Mark of Decay
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them makes their Toxin tick once, healing that ally for it.

skills.name: Scything Rot
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Withered as the first has (max 2).

skills.name: Plague Lord
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and 5 max HP per Withered stack on enemies (as they are when it's used), healing as it rises.

skills.name: Throatcut
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If this executes your Death Mark, a new one goes on a random enemy, hidden.
skills.needs: your Death Mark on the target

skills.name: Coordinated Strike
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each enemy hit gains 1 Toxin per Stealthed ally of the user. Stealthy.

skills.name: Poison Smoke
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies, who gain 1 Toxin each. Then your Death Mark, if it's out, moves (hidden) to the enemy with the least HP.

skills.name: Stiletto
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. Against your Death Mark, the Mark's execute threshold rises by 5 for good (max 40).
skills.needs: your Death Mark on the target

skills.name: Unseen Knife
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Against a Blinded or Sleeping target, the user slips into Stealth for 1 turn.

skills.name: Knockout Poison
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, who falls Asleep for 1 turn, or 2 if they have 4 or more Toxin.

skills.name: Dance of Knives
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each skill they use also deals 5 Piercing damage to your Death Mark's bearer.
skills.needs: your Death Mark on an enemy

skills.name: Subcontract
skills.description: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their skills count as Assassin skills against your Death Mark.
skills.needs: your Death Mark on an enemy

skills.name: Mark for Death
skills.description: Target enemy gains your Death Mark for 3 turns and is Confused for 2. The Mark executes 5 HP higher per Toxin on them when it's placed (max 40).

skills.name: Fan of Knives
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy; the second knife always finds your Death Mark's bearer if it's out. Stealthy.
skills.needs: your Death Mark on an enemy

skills.name: Oakfist
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, plus 5 per 10 max HP the user has gained from Flourish.

skills.name: Treefall
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Can instead target an allied Treant: it's flung at a random enemy for damage equal to its HP, and lands as a fresh Seedling.

skills.name: Heartwood Spear
skills.description: At the end of each of the user's turns while it channels, Channel Growth. In 2 turns, deals 50 damage to target enemy. Channeled.

skills.name: Bedrock Thorn
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, and the user creates a Boulder. For 3 turns, each time an allied Boulder takes damage, Channel Growth.

skills.name: Taproot
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Against a Stunned target, 10 of their max HP moves to the user, counting toward the user's Flourish limit.

skills.name: Tangleweed
skills.description: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns, and meanwhile their skills can't target the user's minions.

skills.name: Barkskin
skills.description: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn; if they have Flourished HP, they also gain 2 Armor for 2 turns.

skills.name: Warden Oak
skills.description: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns by one of the user's minions, or by the user if they have none. A Seedling that survives it Blooms when it ends.

skills.name: Ancient Treant
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and 1 Armor per allied minion, and allied minions are Untargetable.

skills.name: Cracking Foundation
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Each allied Boulder loses 15 HP and adds 5 to every hit.

skills.name: Sheltering Stone
skills.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, or on each ally if your Sanctum is at 3; its user takes 10 Piercing damage. Invisible.

skills.name: Temple Within
skills.description: The user takes in your Sanctum: it ends, and for 3 turns they gain Immune and 1 Might and 1 Armor per level it had (at least 1).

skills.name: Take Sanctuary
skills.description: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If your Sanctum is at 3, it drops to 1 and every ally becomes Invulnerable instead.

skills.name: Tremor of Faith
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to all enemies, +10 per level of your Sanctum; then your Sanctum drops by 1.

skills.name: Stonemason
skills.description: Summons a Stonemason (20 HP) for 3 turns. Carve (r): creates a Boulder, or a Wardstone if your Sanctum is at 2 or more.

skills.name: Ramstone Drill
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +5 per Armor the user has. Then the user loses 1 Armor.

skills.name: Penance in Stone
skills.description: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, +1 turn for each allied Wardstone (up to 3 turns in all).

skills.name: Stone Vow
skills.description: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and while an allied Wardstone stands, it takes half the damage they would.

skills.name: Rampart of Faith
skills.description: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, +10 per allied Boulder and Wardstone; each of those loses 10 HP.

skills.name: Split the Earth
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user has a Boulder, one is ground into the blow, and the user drains a Soul Fragment from each enemy hit.

skills.name: Deathbolt
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, +10 for each Soul Fragment the user spends, up to 3. If it kills them, the spent fragments return to the user, with 1 more.

skills.name: Deathless Drill
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. While the user is Immortal, it also costs them 20 HP and deals 20 more.

skills.name: Bitter Soil
skills.description: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Helpful skill they use while Horrified sprouts a Seedling for the user.

skills.name: Lord of the Grave
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and their minions are Immortal.

skills.name: Quickening Quake
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Then every allied Seedling uses Channel Earth at no cost.

skills.name: Moonburst
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies. Full Moon: Blinded ones fall Asleep after the hit. Waning: the user heals 5 per enemy hit.

skills.name: Moon Moths
skills.description: Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns, and every Blinded enemy is Taunted by one for 1 turn. Flutter (r): 10 damage to target enemy.

skills.name: Silver Severance
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Their Blind ends, and they're Isolated for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Feral Maw
skills.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if the user is Stealthed. Full Moon: it doesn't end the user's Stealth.

skills.name: Crescent Lull
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Neither hit wakes a Sleeping enemy; each Sleeper it hits sleeps 1 turn longer instead.

skills.name: Howl at the Moon
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Full Moon: every allied minion also attacks a random enemy for 10.

skills.name: Heaven's Hammer
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user is Exalted, it's spent to bring the Hammer down on both sides: every ally also heals 25.

skills.name: Crusader's Advance
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. If the target is Condemned, it triggers now, and the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

skills.name: Seclusion
skills.description: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If they're Anointed, it's spent, and they're Exalted until the end of their next turn.

skills.name: Unfailing Grace
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Until the end of the user's next turn, their skills don't spend their Anointed.

skills.name: Avatar
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user is Exalted and gains 2 Armor. Whenever they Condemn an enemy, a random ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

skills.name: Crusader's Wrath
skills.description: Spends all the user's Fervor: deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +10 to each hit per stack spent.

skills.name: Penitent's Flail
skills.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. The user spends 1 Fervor, if they have one, to heal 15.

skills.name: Inquisition
skills.description: For 3 turns, target enemy has Trap 15, and each skill they use Condemns them again. Invisible.

skills.name: Votive Dagger
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If it kills them, the user's allies get the Martyr payout for the user's Fervor, and the user keeps it.

skills.name: Strip the Faithless
skills.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each Horrified enemy loses a random Buff at the start of their turn.

skills.name: Willing Martyrs
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and each of its targets heals 10 per Fervor the user has. Invisible.

skills.name: Heretics' Circle
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy, and 15 to each other enemy with a Debuff, if the target has one too.

skills.name: Sermon of Dread
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Each Horrified enemy is also Condemned.

skills.name: Strike Me Down
skills.description: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. If the user is killed meanwhile, their killer takes 10 Affliction damage per Fervor stack the user had.

skills.name: Living Saint
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. When it ends, they're a Martyr without dying: their allies get the Martyr payout for the user's Fervor, which is then spent.

skills.name: The Hunt Begins
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and their skills are Stealthy while any enemy is Exposed.

skills.name: Quiet Verdict
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Used from Stealth, it makes their Condemned trigger at once.

skills.name: Take Down
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Exposed, it ends, and they're Stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chokehold
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, who falls Asleep for 1 turn. An Exposed target is Stunned for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Mask On
skills.description: The user gains Stealth and 1 Swiftness. While they stay Stealthed, their skills deal 10 more to Exposed enemies.

skills.name: Full Sentence
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctifies them for 1 turn. The next time their Condemned triggers, within 3 turns, it gives all three of its Debuffs.

skills.name: Dawn Vigil
skills.description: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Each Anointed ally spends their Anointed to remove all their Debuffs.

skills.name: Sweep the Streets
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. For 2 turns, each time either one's Condemned triggers, they're also Blinded for 1 turn.

skills.name: Nightwarden
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune. Each time their Stealth ends meanwhile, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

skills.name: Soulgrinder
skills.description: Deals 40 damage to target enemy; their allies are Horrified for 2 turns. Tithe 2: per Fragment spent, a random one of those allies takes 15 Affliction damage.

skills.name: Bone Needle
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, plus 5 per Soul Fragment the user has. If the target is Unhallowed, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them.

skills.name: Deathless Step
skills.description: The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn. Tithe 1: they become Invulnerable for 1 turn instead. Invisible.

skills.name: Profane Bolt
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If they're Unhallowed, the user also heals them 15, which Unhallowed turns into damage; otherwise they're Horrified for 2 turns.

skills.name: Soulfire Nova
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies, plus 10 per Soul Fragment the user has. For 1 turn, any healing they receive also heals the user.

skills.name: Dark Gift
skills.description: Target ally gains Lifesteal for 2 turns. Tithe 2: also 1 Might per Fragment spent, for 2 turns.

skills.name: Soul Rot
skills.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. Tithe 1: for 2 turns, each ally who damages them gains a Soul Fragment.

skills.name: Betrayal
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 10 to them and to each of the user's allies. Tithe 1: the allies are spared.

skills.name: Wretched Bulwark
skills.description: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, plus 10 drained as Affliction damage from each Unhallowed or Horrified enemy.

skills.name: Lord of Souls
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains Lifesteal and 1 Armor per Soul Fragment they have (max 4), but can't spend Soul Fragments.

skills.name: Crushing Malediction
skills.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Each Hex on the target is copied, for 2 turns, to a random ally of theirs.

skills.name: Hex Ward
skills.description: For 1 turn, counters every Harmful skill used on the user by a Hexed enemy, and the first one from anyone else. Invisible.

skills.name: Cursed Hunger
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains Lifesteal, and +5 damage (1 Might) for each Hexed enemy, up to 3, counted as they hit.

skills.name: Doom
skills.description: On the following turn, deals 40 damage to target enemy; it consumes their Hexes for 15 more each, and those Hexes don't Linger. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.

skills.name: Familiar's Cover
skills.description: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. For 2 turns, their Lifesteal also heals them for damage their minions deal.

skills.name: Feed on Misery
skills.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Each Hex on them is shortened by 1 turn, and the user heals 10 more per Hex shortened.

skills.name: Cursed Dagger
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If they're Hexed, they also gain a random Hex for 2 turns.

skills.name: Tongue-Tied
skills.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and their Hexes last 1 turn longer. The user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn. Invisible.

skills.name: Ill Wind
skills.description: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and their Hexes can't be removed meanwhile.

skills.name: The Accursed
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and at the end of each of their turns, every Hex on enemies deals its bearer 5 Affliction.

skills.name: Void Walker
skills.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune. Each time a skill of theirs ends their Stealth, its targets are Blinded for 1 turn. Stealthy.

skills.name: Unwatched Knife
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. Knifing an Isolated target, alone and unwatched, gives the user Stealth.

skills.name: Rend Space
skills.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; any Blind or Isolation on them lasts 2 turns longer.

skills.name: Lifeline Weave
skills.description: All allies heal 20 and are Entangled together for 2 turns, but only Buffs pass through this link.

skills.name: Shear
skills.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies, repeated at the start of the user's next turn if they're still Stealthed. Stealthy.
